svg.title: Maze Maker roadmap, as of 2026-11-01
svg.desc: Maze Maker roadmap as of 2026-11-01. Phase 1, the table and the viewer, closed 2026-11-01: 1.0 Skeleton done; 1.1 First look at the table done; 1.2 Explore one tile folded into 2.2; 1.3 Filter the table done; 1.4 Table checks dropped; 1.5 Full tile set v1 dropped. Phase 2, sample mazes, in progress: 2.1 First sample maze done. Tool track: 2.2 Why is this here? in progress, then 2.3 Tune and compare (adds opening pressure), 2.4 Watch it collapse and 2.5 Judge many samples, all pending. Engine track: 2.6 Beyond the edge, paused; its new shape waits on Yew’s record replacing DR-0031. Step 1 chunk generator partly built and paused; step 2 measures and step 3 view and review pending; step 3 after 2.2 lands. 2.6 goes ahead of 2.4 and 2.5. The game, its own app after Phase 2, pending: walk a maze grown around the player, then keep the world when the player walks back, then a debug mode. Later, not scheduled: zones, and rooms with no way in.
svg.text: As of 2026-11-01 · drawn from docs/roadmap.md · each phase reads left to right, phases top to bottom
Phase 1: the table and the viewer
2.1 done; two tracks run in parallel
